text.en:
Amendment. Sections 1 and 2 of EO No. 101 (s. 2020), as
amended by EO No. 27 (s. 2023), is hereby further amended to read as follows:
"Section 1. Creation of the Inter-Agency Task Force on Zero
Hunger. The Inter-Agency Task Force on Zero Hunger (Task Force on Zero
Hunger) is hereby created, to be composed of the following:
Chairperson
:Secretary, Department of Social Welfare and
Development
Co-Chairperson
Executive Director, National Nutrition Council
Vice-Chairperson : Secretary, Department of Agriculture
:Secretary, Department of Agrarian Reform;
Secretary, Department of Budget and Management;
Secretary, Department of Education;
Secretary, Department of Environment and Natural
Secretary, Department of Health;
Secretary, Department of Labor and Employment;
Secretary, Department of the Interior and Local
Government;
Secretary, Department of Trade and Industry;
Secretary, Department of Science and Technology;
Secretary, Presidential Communications Office;
Secretary, National Economic and Development
Chairperson, Commission on Higher Education; and
Director-General, Technical Education and Skills
Development Authority.
The Task Force on Zero Hunger members may designate an alternate
to represent their respective offices in their absence. Such alternate must be
fully authorized to decide for and on behalf of the Task Force on Zero Hunger
As may be necessary and upon the approval of the President and/or
the Executive Secretary, the Task Force on Zero Hunger is hereby authorized
to further reorganize its composition, subject to existing laws, rules and
regulations.
2

Powers and Functions of the Task Force. The Task Force
on Zero Hunger shall ensure that government policies, initiatives and projects
on attaining zero hunger shall be coordinated, responsive and effective.
Towards this end, the Task Force on Zero Hunger shall have the following
powers and functions:
Ensure the continuous and effective implementation of the
Enhanced Partnership Against Hunger and Poverty Program;
g. Perform such other functions as may be directed by the President
and/or the Executive Secretary."
Section 2. Unaffected Provisions. Except as expressly modified by this Order,
all other provisions of EO No. 101 (s. 2020) shall remain in full force and effect.

Repeal. EO No. 27 (s. 2023) is hereby repealed. All orders, rules,
regulations and issuances or parts thereof, which are inconsistent with this Order, are
hereby repealed or modified accordingly.

Separability. If any provision of this Order is declared invalid or
unconstitutional, the remaining provisions not affected thereby shall continue to be in
full force and effect.

Effectivity. This Order shall take effect immediately upon its
publication in the Official Gazette or in a newspaper of general circulation.
DONE, in the City of Manila, this 06
year of our Lord, Two Thousand and Twenty-Four.
day of August
By the President:
LUCAS P.BERSAMIN
/Exegutive Secretary
